rationale.consistency: Uses standard library slices and maps functions matching Go 1.21+ idioms seamlessly with existing code.
rationale.edge_cases: Handles nil options map, removes leaked order state, and correctly sequences multiple order directives.
rationale.scope: Strictly solves the concurrency and state leakage problems without unrelated refactoring.
rationale.readability: Logic is straightforward, comments explain the lifecycle of the state clearly, and helper functions are well-named.
rationale.robustness: Eliminates global state mutation during adaptation, preventing race conditions and leaving state clean on failure.
rationale.maintainability: Centralizes per-adaptation directive order resolution and prevents accidental global mutations.
